projects.title: Crafted With Purpose & Precision
projects.subtitle: A curated selection of web applications, full stack solutions, and UI/UX designs built with modern technologies.

exstad.title: exSTAD
exstad.shortDescription: A scholarship and education platform designed to provide information about programs, enrollment, scholars, and learning roadmaps.
exstad.longDescription: exSTAD is a production-grade education platform built for the ISTAD ecosystem. It centralizes educational program offerings, online application workflows, scholar directories, and interactive skill learning roadmaps. Backed by Keycloak enterprise single-sign-on (SSO), it delivers secure authentication for students, teachers, and administrators.
features: Enterprise Single Sign-On (SSO) integration using Keycloak
Interactive step-by-step curriculum and scholarship learning roadmaps
Comprehensive administrative dashboard for scholar enrollment approvals
Searchable scholar directory with profile showcase

taskify.title: Taskify
taskify.shortDescription: A task management web application designed to help users create, organize, assign, and track tasks efficiently.
taskify.longDescription: Taskify empowers agile teams and individual professionals to manage their projects effortlessly. Featuring visual Kanban drag-and-drop boards, customizable workflow stages, task priority flags, deadline reminders, and real-time team collaboration, it bridges the gap between clean UX and robust backend persistence.
features: Interactive Kanban boards with smooth drag-and-drop mechanics
Real-time task filtering by tag, priority, and assigned team members
RESTful Spring Boot API backend backed by PostgreSQL persistence
Responsive interface built with Tailwind CSS and TypeScript safety

techdeal.title: TechDeal
techdeal.shortDescription: A modern e-commerce web platform for browsing, comparing, and purchasing tech electronics and accessories with intuitive shopping cart flow.
techdeal.longDescription: TechDeal is an end-to-end tech gadgets marketplace developed with React and Spring Boot. It provides seamless catalog browsing, dynamic faceted filtering (brand, price, ratings), detailed product specs comparisons, real-time cart state management, and order checkout flows.
features: Interactive catalog with multi-facet filters (category, brand, price)
Dynamic shopping cart with persistent storage and instant subtotal calculation
Detailed product pages with specification comparison matrices
RESTful Spring Boot API endpoints for catalog and order management

mobileApis.title: Mobile APIs | Spring Boot
mobileApis.shortDescription: High-performance backend RESTful APIs engineered with Spring Boot for mobile banking transactions and client account operations.
mobileApis.longDescription: Engineered specifically for mobile banking client integration, Mobile APIs delivers a secure, production-tested stateless REST architecture. Features include role-based access control (RBAC), JWT authentication, transaction tracking, fund transfers, error handling middlewares, and interactive OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation.
features: JWT token-based authentication and secure role-based endpoint authorization
Transactional banking endpoints for balance inquiry, deposits, and transfers
PostgreSQL relational schema with Hibernate/JPA repository layers
Interactive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation for smooth mobile client integration

productInventory.title: Product Inventory Management | Java
productInventory.shortDescription: A console-based inventory management system developed in Core Java featuring CRUD operations, table formatting, pagination, and stock tracking.
productInventory.longDescription: Engineered to master object-oriented programming principles and system design in Java, this console application provides a complete terminal-based solution for warehouse management. It features custom ASCII tabular rendering, pagination for large datasets, search by barcode/name, and persistent data storage.
features: Interactive console-based menu with formatted ASCII table output
Full CRUD capabilities: create, read, update, delete, and restore products
In-memory pagination and fast search by ID, name, or product category
Robust input validation, exception handling, and persistent data storage

personalPortfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
personalPortfolio.shortDescription: A responsive personal portfolio showcasing my development, UI/UX, and design work.
personalPortfolio.longDescription: A developer portfolio crafted with an emphasis on minimalist aesthetics, subtle animations, typography hierarchy, and top-tier Lighthouse performance. Built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Motion, it features dynamic theme switching, bilingual Khmer/English support, interactive modal drawers, and responsive layouts across all viewports.
features: Lightning-fast Next.js App Router with server-side metadata optimization
Bilingual Khmer (Krasar font) and English localization engine
Custom micro-interactions, scroll reveals, and smooth page transitions
Minimalist dark & light aesthetic with theme persistence

exstadUxui.title: exSTAD
exstadUxui.shortDescription: Complete user interface and experience design for the exSTAD scholarship platform, featuring responsive dashboards and learning roadmaps.
exstadUxui.longDescription: The exSTAD UI/UX project was researched and crafted in Figma to solve real usability challenges faced by students applying for scholarships. The design delivers a modular design system, accessible color contrast ratios, clear stepper forms for application submissions, and interactive scholar roadmaps.
features: Comprehensive Figma design system with tokens for typography, spacing, and colors
Multi-step scholarship application flow tested for minimal user drop-off
Interactive scholar roadmap interface with visual progress milestones
High-fidelity interactive prototypes for both desktop and mobile viewports

taskifyUxui.title: Taskify
taskifyUxui.shortDescription: Ergonomic and minimalist UI/UX design for Taskify, emphasizing Kanban board visual clarity, dark mode aesthetics, and micro-interactions.
taskifyUxui.longDescription: Designed in Figma with a focus on developer productivity and mental clarity. The interface reduces visual fatigue through clean neutral palettes with intentional accent states, smooth card grab-and-drag states, and quick-filter interaction drawers.
features: Ergonomic Kanban board layout tailored for agile sprint planning
Complete light and dark mode variants crafted with WCAG accessibility standards
Micro-interaction specs for drag handles, modal overlays, and quick task cards
Component variant library in Figma with auto-layout and interactive states

techdealUxui.title: TechDeal
techdealUxui.shortDescription: Modern e-commerce UI/UX design engineered for high conversion rates, streamlined product discovery, and friction-free mobile checkout.
techdealUxui.longDescription: TechDeal's UI/UX architecture focuses on user engagement, effortless product comparison, and trustworthy checkout patterns. Crafted with extensive competitive benchmarking, the design features sticky action bars for mobile shoppers, clear technical spec breakdown tabs, and a 2-step checkout flow.
features: Intuitive product discovery with multi-facet filters and comparative matrices
Frictionless 2-step checkout flow designed to minimize cart abandonment
Mobile-first responsive wireframes and high-fidelity interactive screens
Design system components with responsive grids and e-commerce UI tokens

dambaulUxui.title: Dambaul - Mini Project
dambaulUxui.shortDescription: A mobile application UI/UX mini project ('Dambaul') helping students and young workers easily find safe and budget-friendly rental rooms in Cambodia.
dambaulUxui.longDescription: Dambaul (ដំបូល) was created as a focused UI/UX mini project addressing the lack of centralized housing information for university students relocating to Phnom Penh. The app design features localized map browsing, filter by price and university proximity, owner verification badges, and direct messaging.
features: Map-centric room discovery with radius filtering around major universities
Transparent price breakdown including estimated utilities (water & electricity)
Trust badges and verified room photos to prevent rental scams
Bilingual Khmer-English interface with friendly typography and visual hierarchy

acledaUxui.title: ACLEDA UX/UI Clone
acledaUxui.shortDescription: A modern UX/UI redesign and clone of ACLEDA Mobile Banking app, enhancing navigation speed, QR scanning ergonomics, and bilingual readability.
acledaUxui.longDescription: A UX study and interface overhaul of Cambodia's prominent mobile banking application. The project restructured complex menu hierarchies into an accessible 4-tab navigation, gave KHQR scanning prominent thumb-reach placement, modernized transaction histories with smart categories, and refined Khmer typography.
features: Modernized mobile banking dashboard with quick-balance privacy toggle
Ergonomic KHQR scan & pay workflow positioned for single-hand thumb reach
Streamlined fund transfer sequence with recipient avatars and instant confirmation
Refined Khmer font hierarchy and balanced contrast for both bright sunlight and dark environments

publicSchoolMis.title: Public School MIS — Mobile Screen
publicSchoolMis.shortDescription: A mobile-first school management interface designed for Cambodian students and parents, focusing on attendance, homework, grades, schedules, and notifications.
publicSchoolMis.longDescription: Created to modernize public school communications and student tracking across Cambodia, Public School MIS offers a mobile-first interface optimized for everyday student and parent accessibility. Designed in Figma with native Khmer typography considerations, the system streamlines daily attendance tracking, homework distribution, real-time grading reports, timetable schedules, and school announcements.
features: Mobile-first responsive design engineered for smartphone access and thumb ergonomics
Optimized Khmer typography (Krasar font) and bilingual layout structure
Visual student grade report cards, schedule timetables, and real-time attendance tracking
Complete Figma component design system with reusable UI tokens and interactive mobile screens
